text:
ITEM 1 | Large pale pinkish-cream piece of cooked meat, smooth moist surface with slight sheen, fibrous edges, roughly 9 cm long by 6 cm wide, sitting on top of rice at the upper-left of the plate, occupying about 20% of the plate, roughly 2.5 cm thick | 180
ITEM 2 | Second pale pinkish-cream piece of the same cooked meat, moist and slightly glossy, roughly 7 cm by 5 cm, overlapping the first piece's right side in the center of the plate, about 2 cm thick, covering about 12% of the plate | 120
ITEM 3 | Loose pale yellowish-white grains with separate kernels and some clumping, slightly moist, lying under and around the meat pieces, with reddish-orange flecks and a golden-brown crusty patch on the left edge, covering about 20% of the plate in a flat layer about 1 cm thick | 110
ITEM 4 | Dark green wilted leafy greens with darker veins and glossy wet sheen, folded in small clumps, scattered along the lower-center and right of the meat, covering about 10% of the plate, about 1 cm thick | 45
ITEM 5 | Small dark reddish-brown pieces, slightly shriveled with a matte surface, scattered among the greens and rice near the center, about 1 cm each, covering under 2% of the plate | 6
ITEM 6 | Small yellow-orange round halved fruit with glossy translucent skin and a wet cut face, about 3 cm across, sitting at the lower-right edge of the plate next to the rice, covering about 3% of the plate | 20
ITEM 7 | Thin brownish-orange glossy sauce film pooled on the rice at the left edge and under the meat, with a slightly sticky sheen, covering about 5% of the plate, a few millimeters thick | 12
